source_receipts.normalized_excerpt: The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.4 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in October after rising 0.6 percent in September. The index for shelter rose 0.3 percent in October, accounting for over thirty percent of the monthly all items increase. The food index increased 0.5 percent in October. The index for energy increased 0.7 percent over the month following a 5.2-percent increase in September. The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent, as it did in September and August. BLS did not collect survey data for October 2025 because of a lapse in appropriations; for most CPI series, BLS could not publish October 2025 indexes and cannot publish 12-month percent changes for October 2026 where October 2025 data are unavailable. October 2026 CPI release embargo lifted 8:30 a.m. ET, November 10, 2026.
